violation_type.title: Parent right to file a complaint (26 TAC §746.521(2))
violation_type.short_title: Parent right to file a complaint
violation_type.typical_finding: Information gathered in the investigation substantiated that care was discontinued for a child because a parent contacted law enforcement with an allegation of neglect.

finding_variants.text: Information gathered in the investigation substantiated that care was discontinued for a child because a parent contacted law enforcement with an allegation of neglect.
During the course of this investigation, it was determined a child's care services were terminated for filing a complaint.

Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found noncompliant with the Minimum Standards for Child Care Centers. The operation disenrolled the family because the family filed a complaint.
Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that a parent?s right?s to file a complaint was bribed to avoid an investigation inspection.
